kabuto-night-slash.name: Night Slash
kabuto-night-slash.description: Bond skill: a slash from the shadows (Power 95, Attack).

kabuto-aqua-jet.name: Aqua Jet
kabuto-aqua-jet.description: Bond skill: jets up to 2 hexes into a foe (Power 55, Attack) and engages it.

kabuto-endure.name: Endure
kabuto-endure.description: Bond skill: braces inside its shell, becoming Protected for 1 turn.

kabuto-sharp-claws.name: Sharp Claws
kabuto-sharp-claws.description: Deals 15% more damage to adjacent foes.

kabuto-shell-hunker.name: Shell Hunker
kabuto-shell-hunker.description: Takes 20% less damage while at full HP.

kabuto-leer.name: Leer
kabuto-leer.description: New skill: an intimidating glare leaves a foe up to 2 hexes away Exposed for 2 turns.

kabuto-rock-tomb.name: Rock Tomb
kabuto-rock-tomb.description: New skill: drops rocks on a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 50); Slow for 2 turns.

kabuto-fossil-hunter.name: Fossil Hunter
kabuto-fossil-hunter.description: Deals 10% more damage, and another 10% more to foes with a status.

kabuto-ancient-carapace.name: Ancient Carapace
kabuto-ancient-carapace.description: Foes that hit it from an adjacent hex take 6 damage.

kabuto-razor-shell.name: Razor Shell
kabuto-razor-shell.description: New skill: slashes an adjacent foe with its sharp shell edge (Power 60).

kabuto-rapid-spin.name: Rapid Spin
kabuto-rapid-spin.description: New skill: spins into a foe (Power 40) and breaks off from engaged foes.

kabuto-scythe-arms.name: Scythe Arms
kabuto-scythe-arms.description: Each hit in a row on the same foe deals 10% more damage (max 3).

kabuto-fossil-patience.name: Fossil Patience
kabuto-fossil-patience.description: Heals 3% more max HP per turn while engaged.

kabuto-rock-slide.name: Rock Slide
kabuto-rock-slide.description: New skill: drops rocks on a 1-hex area up to 1 hex away (Power 70).

kabuto-waterfall.name: Waterfall
kabuto-waterfall.description: New skill: charges up a torrent into a foe (Power 80), pushing it back 1 hex.

kabuto-ambush-predator.name: Ambush Predator
kabuto-ambush-predator.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes at full HP.

kabuto-sharpened-shell.name: Sharpened Shell
kabuto-sharpened-shell.description: Its free strikes on foes breaking away deal 30% more damage.

kabuto-stone-edge.name: Stone Edge
kabuto-stone-edge.description: New skill: stabs a foe with jagged stone (Power 100).

kabuto-swords-dance.name: Swords Dance
kabuto-swords-dance.description: New skill: a frenzied dance that leaves it Focused for 3 turns.

kabuto-living-fossil.name: Living Fossil
kabuto-living-fossil.description: Each knockout it lands gives the team 1 Bond.

kabuto-blade-rush.name: Blade Rush
kabuto-blade-rush.description: Knocking out a foe on its turn gives back 2 movement.

kabuto-reaper-of-the-shallows.name: Reaper of the Shallows
kabuto-reaper-of-the-shallows.description: Capstone. Knockouts refresh its basic attack; deals 20% more damage below half HP.

kabuto-prehistoric-survivor.name: Prehistoric Survivor
kabuto-prehistoric-survivor.description: Capstone. Sheds statuses foes put on it each turn; survives one knockout blow per battle at 1 HP.
